name: Interpolated Pre-Integrated Lighting
aliases: Lighting method for pre-integrated volume rendering
definition: A lighting method that eliminates discontinuities by linearly interpolating illumination along the view direction between front and back sample planes, using two pairs of lookup tables (front-weighted and back-weighted) for diffuse and specular contributions.
summary: Interpolated Pre-Integrated Lighting achieves discontinuity-free volume rendering by linearly interpolating lighting integrals between front and back sample planes, eliminating artifacts at transparent boundaries.
